name: upload
description: Save a file to Dropbox. Pass either file (an attachment) or text. Up to 25 MB. Without overwrite, an existing file is kept and the new one gets a numbered name.

path.description: Destination path including the file name, e.g. /Documents/notes.txt.

text.description: Text to save as the file's content, instead of file.

overwrite.description: Replace a file already at path. Default false.
